author: fenglin
model: Local deterministic protocol fixtures in an official host. No live model accounts were used.

checks.name: the native preset selector offers a single Spirit entry
full package mounts and native agent executes Spirit tools
model tool roster exposes continuity tools without owner control setters
native blank reuse preserves Spirit preset and tools while respecting explicit and unmanaged choices
native owner-created conversation inherits active work on its first request and can revise it for the whole profile
declining a real owner request records model authorship and creates no task
real rc.5 context overflow and native compaction retain the current orientation and do not revive cancelled work
Team disabled leaves ordinary native spawn operational with isolated context and a child-attributed result
native fork sees completed root context, mutates the shared Team task board as a named member and returns a child-attributed result
Team member messages and the live roster preserve native member names and authorship
native delegation revocation and stop abort work and background jobs without replaying queued work or affecting another preset
a new native follow-up can continue the member under workspace access without restoring the revoked input
native create/read/post preserves self attribution and workspace membership
session-local model and reasoning effort reach native requests
ask mode awaits and records native rejection before mutation
pause withdraws a pending native approval before its mutation
permission changes invalidate an outstanding native approval grant
full permission uses the selected standing access without extra asks
self-change verifies through native shell, refuses failed checks, applies and rolls back a local candidate
restart preserves the selected Team mode and shared task history in the native Lead Session
restart preserves awaiting_decision and never duplicates an accepted background turn
restart preserves native logs/model choice and one-shot revisit reaches spirit_decide
parallel permission/pause controls converge and revoke queued native activity
fault injection: delayed native pause flush cannot overtake newer resume permission state
fault injection: permission/pause/resume overlap reconciles the latest owner revision
direct native input while paused invokes neither model stream nor tool action
pause prevents deadline dispatch while keeping unresolved intentions
pause cancels active inference and stop prevents future autonomous actions
full access offers an event-free idle opportunity and preserves the native self-authored input
quiet orientation suppresses further event-free model requests
owner pause keeps an open orientation idle across another due interval
withdrawing full access aborts an admitted idle model turn and still accepts later owner input
an event-free opportunity can end silently without recording a judgment or blocking the next opportunity

checks: the started legacy sessions use the only Spirit preset on their first upgraded model requests
owner permission revision and cancelled approval are retained and a new sensitive call requires a new approval
revoked work, owner-stopped work and the accepted dispatch do not replay automatically
explicit recovery uses a fresh native dispatch and the stored revisit executes once
the migrated preset selection persists through a subsequent rc.5 restart
new conversations and workers use full permissions and the worker completes its first task

browser.installation: dsh plugin add link: with a fresh profile from the official Web template

notEvaluated: Live-model long-term autonomous learning, subjective consciousness or behavior improvement
Real token exhaustion at a particular window size. The local adapter produced a context-overflow error that caused the real rc.5 compaction path to run.
